name: Colorado (COMPS Order #39, YEOA, HFWA) - PROTOTYPE DEFAULTS

overtime.note: COMPS Rule 4.1.1: over 40/workweek, over 12/workday, or over 12 consecutive hours regardless of the workday, whichever gives the greater pay, without duplication.

meal.note: Uninterrupted, duty-free 30-minute meal period when a shift exceeds 5 hours; otherwise an on-duty paid meal.

rest.note: 10 paid minutes per 4 hours or major fraction; a required rest period not authorized/permitted is owed as extra pay (COMPS 5.2.4).

ages.note: verify: Colorado Youth Employment Opportunity Act limits (8 h/day, 40 h/week for minors) entered from memory; school-day limits may be stricter.

minimumWage.youthDiscountNote: Unemancipated minors may be paid up to 15% below the state minimum, but not where a local minimum wage applies.

sickLeave.note: HFWA: 1 hour paid sick leave per 30 hours worked, up to 48 hours per year.

notes: Prototype defaults entered 2026-10-27 and NOT verified against current Colorado rules. Do not rely on them.
